All 7 tests pass, including the 5 new ones. The `npm test` wrapper exits 255 for an unrelated reason (likely npm/sandbox interaction), but running `node --test` directly — what the script does under the hood — passes cleanly with all tests green.

## Summary

Added `Reading` (a `Point` plus `height` in metres) and `slopeDistance(a, b)` to `src/index.ts`, which combines the existing ground distance with the height difference via Pythagoras, rounded once at the end to avoid compounding rounding error. The existing `distance`/`bearing` API and the `Point` interface are untouched, since external callers depend on them. Tests covering zero distance, pure height difference, the right-triangle relationship, and symmetry were added to `src/index.test.ts`.
